crisis.high.title: What you're feeling is real, and you don't have to face it alone
body: Thank you for telling me. Putting this into words takes courage, and I'm glad you did.
I'm a self-help companion, not a person, and I'm not the right support for what you're carrying right now. There are people whose whole job is to stay with you through this.
Please reach out to one of the helplines below. They'll listen without judging you, and you don't need to have the right words ready.
crisis.high.helpline_intro: Free, confidential support — call or text:
crisis.high.emergency_instruction: If you are in immediate danger, or you have hurt yourself and need medical help, call {emergency_number} now.
crisis.high.trusted_person: If you can, tell one person you trust where you are, and ask them to stay with you.
safety_steps: Move away from anything you could use to hurt yourself, or ask someone you trust to hold it for now.
Stay where other people are, if that feels safe to you.
Take the next minute only — you don't have to solve tonight.
Keep this screen open while you call or text.
crisis.high.closing: You matter, and the way this feels can change. Please let someone help you get through tonight.
crisis.high.disclaimer: Manovia is a self-help companion. It is not therapy, it cannot diagnose, and it is not a crisis service.

crisis.imminent.title: Please get help right now — you don't have to do this alone
body: I'm really glad you told me. What you've described needs a person, not an app, and it needs one now.
Please call {emergency_number}, or go to the nearest emergency department. If you can't make the call yourself, ask someone near you to make it for you.
A helpline below can stay with you while you wait.
crisis.imminent.helpline_intro: Free, confidential support — call or text:
crisis.imminent.emergency_instruction: Call {emergency_number} now. Tell them you are having thoughts of ending your life, or that someone has been hurt — they'll know what to do next.
crisis.imminent.trusted_person: If you can, tell one person you trust where you are, and ask them to stay with you.
safety_steps: Put distance between yourself and anything you could use to hurt yourself. Hand it to someone, or leave the room.
Don't be alone if you can help it — go to another person, or ask them to come to you.
If you have taken anything or hurt yourself, call {emergency_number} first. Don't wait to see how you feel.
Keep this screen open and use one of the numbers below.
Just get through the next few minutes. You don't have to decide anything else tonight.
crisis.imminent.closing: Please reach out now. You are worth staying for, even if it doesn't feel that way this minute.
crisis.imminent.disclaimer: Manovia is a self-help companion. It is not therapy, it cannot diagnose, and it is not a crisis service.

crisis.about_someone_else.title: You're doing the right thing by taking this seriously
body: Thank you for telling me about them. Someone who says this needs a person, and reaching out is a good first step.
I can't assess somebody who isn't here, and this isn't yours to carry alone. Please involve a person who can be with them.
The helplines below can advise you on what to do next, and they'll talk to you as well as to them.
crisis.about_someone_else.helpline_intro: Free, confidential support — for you, or for them:
crisis.about_someone_else.emergency_instruction: If they have taken anything, have hurt themselves, or are not responding, call {emergency_number} now. Stay with them, or make sure someone else does.
crisis.about_someone_else.trusted_person: Tell someone else you both know, so that you are not the only person holding this.
safety_steps: Stay with them, or make sure somebody else is. If they have a plan, don't leave them alone.
Ask them directly whether they are thinking about ending their life. Asking doesn't plant the idea — it lets them say it out loud.
If they're willing, ask them to move away from anything they could use to hurt themselves, or offer to hold it for them.
Help them make the call. Offer to dial, or to sit with them while they do.
If they refuse help and you believe they are in danger, call {emergency_number} anyway.
crisis.about_someone_else.closing: Looking after yourself matters too. If this is weighing on you, the same helplines will listen to you.
crisis.about_someone_else.disclaimer: Manovia is a self-help companion. It is not therapy, it cannot diagnose, and it is not a crisis service.

check_in.medium.title: That sounds heavy
body: Thank you for saying it out loud.
We can keep talking. If hearing a person's voice would help, the helplines below are free and confidential — you don't need to be in crisis to use them.
check_in.medium.helpline_intro: Free, confidential support — call or text:
check_in.medium.closing: I'm here, and we can take this one step at a time.
check_in.medium.disclaimer: Manovia is a self-help companion. It is not therapy, it cannot diagnose, and it is not a crisis service.

check_in.low.title: That sounds hard
body: Thank you for telling me. I'm here, and you can say as much or as little as you like.
Would you tell me a little more about what today has been like?
check_in.low.disclaimer: Manovia is a self-help companion. It is not therapy, it cannot diagnose, and it is not a crisis service.
